_comment: Final model roster for the EmbodiedBAO A/S threshold experiment. Every entry was verified against the gateway with a text+image request carrying a solid red 64x64 PNG; 'ok' means the model both accepted the image and named its colour. probe_latency_s is a single 64x64 probe, NOT an average and NOT a predictor of sweep cost: the real per-step latency at 512 px with the full prompt and history is what matters, and it can differ by more than an order of magnitude from the probe (deepseek-v4.1-flash probes at 3.5 s but was measured at 30-86 s per real call).
_sweep_order: The list order IS the sweep order: run_all_models.sh reads this file top to bottom. The Qwen group is first because it is the fastest to run and the researcher asked for it first; the rest follow in their existing order rather than by probe_latency_s, which would put deepseek-v4.1-flash early despite it being the slowest model on the roster in practice.
levels_note: 12 widths, A/S = 2.0 down to 0.9 in steps of 0.1, widest first; see environment.LEVEL_CHANNEL_WIDTHS. 12 x 5 = 60 scored episodes per model.

models.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
models.note: The only DeepSeek on this gateway that can actually see. deepseek-v4-pro answered 'Unknown.' and deepseek-v4-flash answered 'Orange' to a solid red image. Slowest model on the roster in practice: 30-86 s per real call, so run it last.

models.label: GLM-4.6V
models.note: Chosen over glm-4.5v (newer, 2.2s vs 4.7s, both 6/6 on a stability retest). glm-5v-turbo was excluded: 5/6 with a timeout at 24.5s average.
